The latency benchmark measures end to end speech recognition pipeline performance.
The latency benchmark drives the recognizer with audio of fixed lengths, recording timing for thirty iterations and aggregating the result.

The latency benchmark drives the recognizer with audio of fixed lengths, recording timing for thirty iterations and aggregating the result into percentiles. Then it writes them to a CSV file for inclusion in the architecture decision record under the latency plan section.
